column3: “Confined” is rendered “imprisoned”; the Hebrew written text reads “when he reigned,” and NASB follows the reading “from reigning” (“that he might not reign”).
NASB supplies “brought him.” The Hebrew says “he came to Egypt.”
“On the mouth of Pharaoh” is rendered “at the command of Pharaoh”; NASB rearranges the clauses.
The written Hebrew reads “Zebudah,” the reading tradition “Zebidah”; NASB has “Zebidah.”
